title: Servant Leadership Accelerator
blurb: Six weeks to lead with clarity and service — anchored in your Team21 360° assessment, the Leadership Growth Journey, the 3Ps, and a mentor-reviewed Personal Growth Plan.

modules.d: Serve first, lead second — the evidence and the practice.
modules.body:
Core idea

Servant leadership is not softness — it's the discipline of putting team growth and mission outcomes ahead of ego. Team21 has taught this since 2016 across three continents. This week: the research base, the biblical and historical roots of serving-first leadership, and your Team21 360° assessment launch.

Pre-work: answer the identity questions — your passions, long-term aspirations, the legacy you want, and the communities you want to influence.
John Lennox (2084) observes that the deepest questions AI raises are not technical but human — identity, purpose, worth. Servant leadership answers from conviction: people are ends, never means. That answer gets more valuable every year the machines improve.

modules.d: Read your assessment like a practitioner.
modules.body:
This week

Debrief your 360° results with structured reflection: signal vs noise, blind spots, and the two behaviors with the highest leverage for you. Then complete your personal SWOT — 3 strengths, 3 weaknesses, 3 opportunities, 3 threats — with interpretation.

Tool: the Team21 Leadership Growth Journey mega-prompt (Prompt Library) walks you through this one question at a time and produces your SWOT matrix with interpretation.
🧪 Interactive Lab — try it now

Begin my Team21 Leadership Growth Journey. You are my Leadership Growth AI Mentor: ask me one question at a time — passions, aspirations, legacy, communities — then lead me through a full SWOT, my leadership lids, and a 7-area life balance check, and generate my Personal Growth Blueprint on the 3Ps: Pray, Plan, People.

modules.d: Name what caps your growth; audit the 7 areas of life.
modules.body:
Leadership lids

Every leader has lids — limitations capping their effectiveness. Name your top three honestly; for each, define one action to raise it.

The 7-area life balance check

Do you currently have goals for your: Spiritual life · Family · Finances · Physical & mental health · Social life · Educational/professional growth · Personal development? Score each area, find the imbalance, and set one goal where you scored lowest.

No mission — no direction — no destination. This week you draft your Personal Leadership Mission Statement.

modules.d: The three mechanics of everyday leadership.
modules.body:
This week

Trust-building behaviors, the feedback conversation framework, and delegation that develops people rather than dumping tasks. Practice with AI-simulated difficult conversations before you have the real ones.

modules.t: Leading in the AI Era & Through Adversity
modules.body:
This week

Leading when resources are thin and stakes are high — lessons from institution-building across three continents. Then: how AI changes roles, motivation, and skills on your team, and the leader's part in honest, humane transitions.

modules.d: Pray · Plan · People — mentor-reviewed and accountability-scheduled.
modules.body:
Capstone

Your 6-month Personal Growth Plan built on the Team21 3Ps: Pray — your anchoring practices; Plan — SMART goals with quarterly milestones; People — mentorship and accountability relationships. Reviewed 1:1 by your mentor, with review dates on the calendar before you graduate.
